svg.title: Narrowing with filters in Lite, and with a selection in Expert
svg.desc: In Lite a brush on an axis keeps the options inside it; a second brush on the same axis is an alternative, so options in either range are kept; a brush on another axis must hold as well, which narrows. In Expert a new brush is combined with the current selection by one of five operations: replace, add, subtract, toggle and intersect. Toggle adds the brushed options, or removes them when all of them were selected already.
svg.text: Lite: every brush is a filter
Brushes on the same axis are alternatives (OR). An option must pass the filters on every axis (AND).
Keeps the options inside the range
Keeps the options in either range
Keeps the options that pass both filters
Expert: one selection, and you choose how each brush changes it
S is what is selected, N the new brush. Blue is what is selected afterwards.
when all of N was selected
